text.brief: A war planner at Indo-Pacific Command learns in 2046 that a Party simulation predicted her exercise's moves to the hour. The model runs on data its makers gathered over twenty years.
text.record: A 2020 indictment charged four members of the People's Liberation Army with stealing records on about 145 million Americans from Equifax in 2017. The breach of the Office of Personnel Management in 2015 exposed files on 21.5 million people. CISA reported in 2024 that the Volt Typhoon group had prepositioned itself inside American infrastructure.
text.reading: The Party completes its digital twin of America and uses it to feint. A sound in one domain draws American attention, and the real strike lands where the twin shows the weakest seam. This is Stratagem 6, make a sound in the east, strike in the west.
text.coreEvent: American officials assess that the Party holds a model of America's grid, ports and military logistics accurate enough to plan strikes before 2048.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. American systems leak the data that lets an adversary model them, and they change too slowly to outdate the model.
text.fix: Deny the data, change the shape and seed the adversary's model with decoys.
